$comment: Completion bar for #37: make 'I couldn't find that in your notes' actually fire for off-topic questions. searchQuery drops stopwords (it's → no more "s"*), quotes every term (no FTS operator injection), applies a minimum BM25 score, and the items_fts table now uses the trigram tokenizer (substring + CJK segmentation, migrated in place from unicode61). Retrieval stays OR (recall preserved) so a note matching a subset of a multi-term query still ranks before transcripts.
